meaning:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.19.9
§ Tirhakah = "he searched out the pious: he searched out the waiter"
king of Ethiopia and Egypt in the time of Sennacherib

elsewhere.note: When he heard it said of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, “Behold, he has come out to fight against you, he sent messengers again to Hezekiah, saying,
He heard news concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, “He has come out to fight against you.” When he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
